positions.commentary: g an academic career under the wing of Stephen Covey, Tom found himself recruited by John Mack to work alongside him to develop a positive culture at Morgan Stanley. After eight years in the trenches, he returned to academia as a professor

thesis: Tom DeLong argues that his career has been defined by helping individuals and organizations lead more meaningful lives, a mission he feels is often perceived as too soft for the finance industry. He illustrates this by contrasting the substantive conversations he had at Morgan Stanley with the superficial topics like golf and redecorating that dominated the rest of the culture.
